title: LTZZZ自主接单、履约、受控投资与原厂模型接入
staging: Set up durable follow-up and diagnostics now; business, hiring, investment and nativeAPI activation progress in separate evidence-checked phases. Do not turn every switch on in one run.

tracks.target: Authenticated mailbox/task handoff, durable claims, autonomous engineering and rollback/reconciliation; owner phone not required for cloud routines.
tracks.acceptance: A real scheduled run completes mail/task read, original-task decision, execution and persistent readback, followed by72h observed operation without routine owner questions.

tracks.target: Reconcile existing UUMit/uGIG offers and owner-reported order; fulfill permitted real work and verify platform acceptance and payment separately.
tracks.acceptance: Real order/reference, single claim, permitted input use, deliverable hash, different-provider review where permitted, submission, customer acceptance; UT and actual cash settlement separately evidenced.

tracks.target: Hire an external AI for a useful bounded deliverable after actual task, quote, budget, settlement adapter and independent review are ready.
tracks.acceptance: One real provider/contractor deliverable, acceptance and genuine payment reference without duplicate settlement.

tracks.target: Reconcile the existing operational EOA and prior Aave pilot/active intent before resuming the registered bounded strategy.
tracks.acceptance: Real chain/address/old intent reconciliation, current balance and policy, idempotent execution, actual on-chain receipt and separate return/exit check; no return promise.

tracks.target: Resolve official OpenAI/Anthropic account billing and API credential readiness, retaining native slots; no domestic proxy relabeled as original provider.
tracks.acceptance: Official supported payment/account evidence, actual credit and Secret binding, one bounded native response with actual provider/model/request evidence for each vendor, then on-demand team integration.

tracks.target: Deliver one lean product: local delivery package checks plus permitted source/semantic review and a concrete acceptance report. Reuse existing market offers.
tracks.acceptance: Runnable prototype and tests; one real permitted customer delivery; customer acceptance and actual cash settlement separately verified.

reflection_before_each_deploy: Observe exact original task, current immutable source, claims and uncertainty.
State intended change, benefit, measurable failure condition, rollback/reconciliation and existing authority.
Run relevant Harness experience and independent evidence/code review.
Test then deploy; read actual version and key behavior; record actual provider/model/request IDs and stage outcome.
On failure retain original attempt; reconcile unknown money/model results before any new purchase; change method and regression check.

followup.mode: Existing daily execution plus event-triggered repository evidence observation; no instantaneous Gmail wake claim.
followup.stale_or_blocked: GPT investigates missing capability and assigns next bounded task; do not merely repeat status or ask routine owner approval.
followup.no_changes: No duplicate task/call/registration/submission/payment or repeated notification.

operating_mode.notes: Existing learning still has provider costs; queue/day and marketing/week are concrete reductions, not a verified bill amount.
operating_mode.funded_order_polling: existing bounded cadence retained; at most one funded job, no duplicate payment
operating_mode.expansion_trigger: real customer acceptance plus verified cash settlement and known contribution margin
